guard: a post-connect bind failure announces transport and connection down before the partial connection closes; and a probe that ran out of its own budget is reported as a timeout, never collapsed into unreachable (#851); and the raw off-registry preflight re-probes at the confirm budget before condemning a slow broker (#709); and probeConnect gates a plaintext dial on the broker's INFO greeting, not just the TCP handshake, so a slow greeting cannot orphan the socket (#2156)

mutations.name: failed-bind teardown omits down edges
mutations.find:
this.emit("transport", { connected: false } satisfies TransportState);
    this.emit("connection", { connected: false });
mutations.expectRed: FAILED-BIND EDGES: post-connect bind failure announces transport and connection down
mutations.cell: FAILED-BIND EDGES: post-connect bind failure announces transport and connection down

mutations.name: a probe timeout collapses to unreachable again, so a TLS-required target's slow link reads as a trust failure (#851)
mutations.find: if (e !== undefined && isTimeoutError(e)) return { ok: false, reason: "timeout" };
mutations.replace: if (e !== undefined && isTimeoutError(e)) return { ok: false, reason: "unreachable" };
mutations.expectRed: S11 held-open TLS peer: preflightTarget → slow-link, prune:false (#851 cell a)

mutations.name: the raw off-registry preflight condemns on the first one-second miss again (#709)
mutations.find:
if (!probe.ok && (probe.reason === "timeout" || probe.reason === "unreachable"))
    probe = await probeConnect(server, { ...auth, timeoutMs: PREFLIGHT_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS });
mutations.expectRed: S12 delayed-INFO plain peer: reachableOrThrow resolves through the confirm probe (#709)
mutations.cell: S12 delayed-INFO plain peer: reachableOrThrow resolves through the confirm probe (#709)
mutations.note: #709: without the re-probe, reachableOrThrow condemns a slow-but-live broker on the first 1s miss.

mutations.name: probeConnect's plaintext gate reverts to handshake-only, so a slow greeting orphans the socket again (#2156)
mutations.find: const gate = opts.tls || wsServers(server) ? tcpDialable : tcpInfoProbe;
mutations.expectRed: slow greeting: no live socket handles left in the loop after 5 probes
mutations.cell: slow greeting: no live socket handles left in the loop after 5 probes

why: The second entry is the #851 collapse: a probe timeout reported as `unreachable` makes the workspace
preflight re-read the INFO greeting and report a CA problem for a slow link. Its command rebuilds core
first because the preflight suite imports core through its dist, and it declares no completion marker:
that suite is fail-fast and prints its count line only on a green run.
The third entry is #709: without the confirm re-probe, reachableOrThrow refuses a live broker on the
first 1s miss, so the raw off-registry door (--creds, or --server with an unregistered --space)
reports a real link as down. Its command rebuilds workspace because the preflight suite imports
The fourth entry is #2156: reverting probeConnect's gate choice to the handshake-only tcpDialable
orphans a socket whose greeting arrives after the budget, so the probe-teardown suite's slow-greeting
class sees a live socket handle survive the probe loop. Its command rebuilds core because the
probe-teardown suite imports it through its dist too.
